title: Method: list_profiles
description: Returns all profiles the daemon currently has, along with the id of the active one. The active profile id is tracked at the daemon level and only exposed here.

profiles.description: All profiles known to the daemon, in creation order: create_profile, duplicate_profile and import_profile append at the end. next_profile and previous_profile follow this order.

active_profile_id.description: Identifier of the currently active profile. Always references one of the profiles in the array.
